coverage.method: Read entire assigned source sequentially, including pre-match, all three games and interview.

games.summary: DuDu wins with a burst of burn damage and a Crucible-boosted Everflame Staff.

beats.text: Noel opens three Fractals, adds Extinguishing Synchron and Zhang Jiao, then uses Aenean Frozen Shunt during combat to remove DuDu’s Creative Shock from the stack.
DuDu builds Essence Crucible with Explosive Concoction while Noel establishes Safeguard Amulet and pressures with Refracting Missile.
Shimmering Refraction threatens a large hit; Noel uses Safeguard Amulet against Searing Rebuke, then commits her hand to regain resources.
DuDu responds with Explosive Concoction, Scalding Aethercharge and Intensified Pyres. Everflame Staff receives Essence Crucible’s bonus, and Noel concedes.

games.summary: Noel survives a long burn exchange and finds exact lethal through Safeguard Amulet.

beats.text: Nullifying Lantern shuts down Kindle lines, and Fractal of Intrusion strips DuDu’s Combustible Potion before the Crucible engine gets going.
After DuDu’s Blanche slows the damage, Noel finds Fracturize and removes Essence Crucible. Safeguard Amulet covers the following Searing Rebuke.
Noel commits Extinguishing Synchron during the Enfeebling Orb exchange, counters Searing Rebuke with Glimmering Refusal and uses Frostbind against the next burn line. The Synchron’s healing resolves.
Refracting Missile clears Blanche. Noel adds another Fractal and fires the next Missile for exact lethal through Safeguard Amulet, tying the match.

games.summary: Noel removes Essence Crucible early, breaks through Blanche and completes the comeback.

beats.text: Noel establishes Nullifying Lantern and Zhang Jiao, finds Fracturize, and removes Essence Crucible as DuDu starts brewing.
Searing Rebuke turns DuDu’s self-damage from Fractal of Sparks and a potion into nine damage, but also builds Noel’s Extinguishing Synchron. Spalling Cleanse keeps Noel healthy.
Noel uses Burst Asunder to remove Blanche, then Tidal Fractal mills another Blanche from DuDu’s deck and increases the damage of her remaining spells.
Refracting Missile adds seven damage as DuDu uses Safeguard Amulet. Noel follows with Enfeebling Orb and retains Frostbind; DuDu cannot find an answer and Noel wins the deciding game.

sideboardNotes.text: Noel brings out Nullifying Lantern immediately in game two, restricting DuDu’s Slash and Burn and Intensified Pyre lines.
Blanche, Sheltering Saint and Viridian Protective Trinket appear after sideboarding; Blanche repeatedly blocks Noel’s burn damage.
